intro: Every public meeting where Melbourne Beach's decisions get made — computed live, sourced like everything else here. These rooms are open to you.

recurring.name: Melbourne Beach Town Commission — regular meeting
recurring.place: Community Center, 509 Ocean Ave, Melbourne Beach
recurring.note: The Mayor and four commissioners, who adopt the town budget and set the millage. Public comment is on every regular agenda. Special meetings, workshops, and the September budget hearings are additional — watch the town's notices.
recurring.source: Day and place from the town's own posted regular-meeting agendas (2024–26), each on the third Wednesday. Confirm any single date against the posted agenda.

seasonal.banner: Budget season: between June and September, the Town Commission writes next year's budget and sets the millage. Anything you want changed in the numbers gets said at these meetings — or waits a year.

community.invite: Community events belong here too — send them through the question box.
